items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I had a wonderful opportunity to sing a few times with Jon Hendricks, Aria Hendricks and Kevin Burke

ctx.x: Singers get behind, not many get in front. But I just kind of heard it that way. And if I work with a rhythm section where I’ve never worked with and I tell them I’m going to do that and maybe I’ll open with that, I’ll tell them, “listen, I know where I am. You know, you cats just play the map, I know where I am.” Because lots of times they’ll adjust, “uh oh, he doesn’t know where he is.” The singer. That’s a singer thing. “Oh the singer’s lost, let’s adjust.” Well they should. But they should tell the singer,…
Yeah. A grin from Jon Hendricks.
